skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: Generate hosted AI videos through Luxin without provider credentials or a local runtime. Discover models, estimate costs, create jobs, recover results, and share durable URLs.
skill.summary: Create and manage hosted AI video jobs through the Luxin CLI and API.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Five findings are confirmed because the instructions execute unpinned npm packages and install skills with automatic confirmation. Most backtick, URL, and hidden-path detections are Markdown or explicit workspace configuration. A high-severity semantic finding covers execution of service-supplied commands without local validation.

remediation.issue: The examples execute npm packages without fixed versions and suppress confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package versions, verify package integrity, and remove automatic confirmation from commands intended for agents.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to execute a command returned by the hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Return structured actions instead of shell commands, enforce an executable and argument allowlist, and require a visible approval before execution.

remediation.issue: Installation examples modify global agent skill state with automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Default to workspace-scoped installation and require explicit approval before global installation or agent configuration changes.

content.value_statement: Video generation often requires provider accounts, credentials, billing systems, and job tracking. This skill uses Luxin to guide creation, estimate spending, recover jobs, and return hosted video links.
actual_capabilities: Starts a no-spend guide for the fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled model.
Creates hosted text-to-video jobs from a prompt through the Luxin CLI.
Applies intent and estimated spending limits to generation requests.
Returns durable hosted media URLs, job recovery data, cost receipts, and stable structured responses.
Installs the intent skill for Codex through the skills CLI.
limitations: Requires network access to Luxin and npm services.
Depends on hosted Luxin model availability, latency, policies, credits, and payment support.
Uses external CLI packages and does not include a local video generation runtime.
Generated media quality and completion time depend on the selected hosted model.

use_cases.title: Prototype social video
use_cases.description: Turn a short concept into a hosted motion draft for review and iteration.

use_cases.title: Generate a product reveal
use_cases.description: Generate a ten-second product reveal while setting an estimated spending limit.

use_cases.title: Integrate agent workflows
use_cases.description: Create recoverable video jobs and retain durable URLs for later agent sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the no-spend guide to prepare a ten-second video of [subject] in [style]. Do not create paid media until I approve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a guided video request with clear spending control.

prompt_templates.title: Set visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] video showing [scene]. Use [camera movement], [lighting], and [mood], then report the estimated cost before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Define production details for a focused creative draft.

prompt_templates.title: Compare video models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available Luxin video models for [goal]. Recommend one based on quality, speed, and estimated cost, without starting a paid job.
prompt_templates.scenario: Select a suitable hosted model before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Run an approved workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a hosted video job for [campaign]. Validate required inputs, cap estimated spending at [amount], request approval, then return job status and a durable URL.
prompt_templates.scenario: Manage an advanced generation workflow with recovery and cost controls.

output_examples.input: Prepare a ten-second handheld product reveal without spending credits yet.
output_examples.output: Guide status: ready for input review. Model: fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled. Paid generation remains paused until explicit approval.

output_examples.input: Recommend a video model for a fast animated concept and show the estimated cost.
output_examples.output: Model recommendation: a supported Luxin video model selected for speed. The response includes its estimated cost and required inputs before creation.

output_examples.input: Recover my completed video job and provide the result.
output_examples.output: Job status: complete. The result includes a durable hosted media link and the available cost receipt.

best_practices: Start with the no-spend guide and review missing inputs before creating media.
Set an estimated spending limit and obtain explicit approval before any paid generation.
Keep job identifiers, cost receipts, and hosted URLs for recovery and later citation.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a service-returned command without validating its executable, arguments, and spending effects.
Do not use unpinned npm packages in automated or privileged environments.
Do not redirect HOME or install global skills without understanding the workspace and agent state changes.

faq.question: Do I need provider API credentials?
faq.answer: No provider credentials are required. Luxin may create an optional restricted hosted token for its own service.

faq.question: Can this skill run a local video model?
faq.answer: No. It uses the hosted Luxin runtime and does not provide a local generation server.

faq.question: Does the guide spend credits?
faq.answer: The guide is intended for no-spend preparation. A generation job may consume credits and should require explicit approval.

faq.question: Can I recover a video later?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes recoverable jobs and durable hosted media URLs for later agent sessions.

faq.question: Which video model does the example use?
faq.answer: The examples use fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled. Availability and alternatives depend on the current Luxin catalog.

faq.question: What should I do when Luxin lacks a needed capability?
faq.answer: Use a fallback only for the missing capability, then submit feedback describing the attempted command and result.
